record.original_question: Classify critically finite maps on P3 .

evidence.quote: Problem 10.3.9 Classify critically finite maps on P3 . Complex Analytic Varieties 11.1 Embedding Varieties

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A holomorphic endomorphism $f \colon \mathbb{P}^n(\mathbb{C}) \to \mathbb{P}^n(\mathbb{C})$ of degree $d \geq 2$ is said to be critically finite (or post-critically finite) if its critical set $C_f = \{ z \in \mathbb{P}^n : \det(Df(z)) = 0 \}$ has the property that the post-critical set
$$ \mathrm{PC}(f) = \bigcup_{k \geq 1} f^k(C_f) $$
is an algebraic subvariety of $\mathbb{P}^n$, equivalently, each irreducible component of $C_f$ is preperiodic under $f$.

Problem: Give a complete classification, up to holomorphic conjugacy, of all critically finite holomorphic endomorphisms of $\mathbb{P}^3(\mathbb{C})$ of degree $d \geq 2$.
artifact.category_tag: Critically finite holomorphic maps on projective space
artifact.status_search_result: A complete classification of critically finite holomorphic endomorphisms exists only in lower dimensions and partial settings. Work by Fornaess–Sibony and subsequent authors has studied examples and structural properties (e.g., post-critical orbits, Fatou components, hyperbolicity) of post-critically finite maps on $\mathbb{P}^k$, including some constructions and rigidity results, but no full classification on $\mathbb{P}^3$ appears in the literature. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Critical orbits of holomorphic maps on projective spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies critical orbits for holomorphic maps on projective spaces, generalizing Riemann-sphere results, without giving a P^3 classification.
status_evidence.claim: Research on critically finite maps in higher-dimensional projective spaces is ongoing but no full classification on P^3 is given.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of post-critically finite maps in higher dimension
status_evidence.snippet: Studies post-critically finite endomorphisms of P^k and proves structural results under regularity assumptions on the post-critical set.
status_evidence.claim: Only structural and partial results on post-critically finite endomorphisms of P^k are established, falling short of a classification.
